english.title: Fail to notify authority of intended stocking density of conventionally reared meat chickens - Wales
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were a person responsible for conventionally reared meat chickens at **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), when, without lawful authority or excuse,

(A)_[you, being the keeper,]_
(B)_[the keeper, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),]_

failed to ensure that the Welsh Ministers were notified, in the manner and form required by the Ministers, of

(C)_[the intended stocking density]_
(D)_[a subsequent change to the notified stocking density]_

of each house where it was intended to keep chickens at a density in excess of 33 kilograms per m2 of usable area, at least 15 working days before stocking at

(E)_[that density]_
(F)_[the changed density]_

took place
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(1)(ba), 7(1)(a) and 9 of, and paragraph 4 of Schedule 5A to, the Welfare of Farmed Animals (Wales) Regulations 2007.

other.penalty:
Summary: 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 51 weeks imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation
